## What changed

Describe the observable change and why it belongs in WP Heart Throb.

## Risk and compatibility

- [ ] Existing administration and front-end toolbar behavior remains compatible.
- [ ] PHP 7.4 and WordPress 6.4 compatibility are preserved.
- [ ] Heartbeat timing, request/response keys, asset loading, and animation behavior are described where applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility, privacy, dependency, automation, and release implications are identified.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression coverage was added or the reason it is unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] Changed PHP files pass syntax checks on the supported PHP versions.
- [ ] The toolbar was checked in affected administration and front-end contexts.
- [ ] Shipped PHP, JavaScript, and CSS assets were reviewed when changed.
- [ ] The production artifact contains no development files.
